title: On the Periodicity of k-distance Graphs
summary: The $k$-distance graph $G^k$ of a graph $G$ has the same vertex set as $G$ and two vertices are adjacent if and only if their distance is $k$ in $G$. These graphs have been extensively studied for their connection properties. In this paper, we study various properties of these graphs, including clique number and periodicity. For all $k$, we show that there exists a $k$-distance graph that is weakly periodic for any size period.
